items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Charlie Johnson's band' in Detroit and asks 'Do you remember those names?', but the interviewee (Teddy Wilson) does not respond with any personal anecdote or confirmation of a direct relationship, only acknowledging the interviewer's statement.

ctx.x: (Ed. note- Lang recorded with Johnson in 1928-29 as "Blind Willie Dunn".)
As a matter of fact, the Chocolate Dandies under Benny Carter -- two of the Chocolate Dandies were white when I did it -- Max Kaminsky and Floyd O'Brien were two of the white Chocolate Dandies.
